wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-004 aggregates the weapon ownership/selection functions (giveAmmo, giveWeapon, giveBackpack, checkAmmo) and the weapon psprite-state-machine action functions (fireWeapon, dropWeapon, aWeaponReady, aLower, aRaise, aReFire, aCheckReload, aGunFlash, set/getWeaponStateContext) into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for the weapon ticker. The read-only src/player/weapons.ts and weaponStates.ts already implement vanilla p_inter.c / p_pspr.c semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification.
